people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
translations.bsb: So this weak brother, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
translations.kjv: And through thy knowledge shall ➔ the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
translations.asv: For through thy knowledge he that is weak perisheth, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
